description: Business Analyst Location: Dublin (Hybrid) Role Type: Full-time, Permanent Department: Transformation Office (TO) Are you an analytical powerhouse who thrives on turning complexity into clarity? Do you enjoy looking under the hood of an organisation to find smarter, faster, and better ways of working? Our client is looking for a Business Analyst to serve as the analytical engine of our clients Transformation Office. In this role, you will work cross-functionally to map how our client currently operate and design and how they can excel in the future. From process optimisation to exploring emerging AI tools, you will be at the absolute forefront of driving our clients organisational change. The Role Purpose As a Business Analyst, you will support the delivery of critical transformation projects. You will be responsible for conducting structured analysis, documenting and redesigning business processes, gathering stakeholder requirements, and developing robust business cases and functional specifications. Key Responsibilities Lead Analysis: Drive business analysis activities on assigned projects - including requirements gathering, process mapping, gap analysis, and option appraisals Process Design : Document current-state and target-state business processes to an exceptionally high standard. Project Delivery Assets: Develop business cases, functional specifications, and user acceptance testing (UAT) plans. Stakeholder Engagement : Facilitate workshops and structured interviews across all departments to capture diverse business needs. Framework Development : Support the design of our policy and process architecture framework, and contribute to data governance frameworks (specifically regarding process-level data requirements). PMO Support : Assist the Transformation Lead with programme portfolio administration and project repo rting. Change Manag ement: Champion training and change management activities alongside new process implementations. Skills & Experience Required The Essentials: Experience: 1 to 3 years of proven experience in a Business Analysis, Process Improvement, or Operational Excellen ce role. Methodologies: Solid exposure to process optimization, Lean, or Six Sigma pri nciples. Project Lifecycle: Demonstrated experience leading Projects and Change Requests from end -to-end. Technical Skills: Elite process mapping skills with high proficiency in Visio, Lucidchart, or equivalen t tools. Systems Exposure : Experience working with ERP or CRM systems (e.g., Business Central, Salesforce, or s imilar). Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; a proven ability to translate complex, technical processes into accessible documentation. Mindset : An analytical mindset with sharp attention to detail and a highly structured approach to problem - solving. Education: Relevant qualification in Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related field. Desirable (Nice to Have):Experience working within the Education or Finance sectors. Background in financial and administrative process environments. A forward-thinking understanding of emerging Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies and tools, with an eye for identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and business performance.
title: Business Analyst

description: Die RIB-Gruppe ist der weltweit führende Anbieter von Softwarelösungen für die Steuerung von Projekt- und Unternehmensprozessen in der Bau- & Immobilienbranche. Mehr als 60 Jahre Branchenerfahrung befähigen uns, unser Ziel, die Bauindustrie zur nachhaltigsten und digitalisiertesten Branche des 21. Jahrhunderts voranzutreiben, mit unseren Kunden erfolgreich zu erreichen: „Building Better Together“. Die Vision, Bauprojekte durch digitale Arbeitsmethoden effizienter und transparenter zu machen, haben wir in den letzten Jahren bei unseren Kunden Realität werden lassen - doch damit geben wir uns noch nicht zufrieden: wir wollen der Bauindustrie die Spitzenposition der Zukunft sichern! Dies ermöglichen unsere 2.500 Mitarbeiter*innen weltweit; davon > 500 Mitarbeiter*innen in DACH. Als eigenständiges Unternehmen der Schneider Electric eröffnen wir dir dabei nationale und internationale Karrierechancen und sinnstiftende Aufgaben in kaufmännischen und technischen Bereichen. Sei ein Teil davon #ONERIB We are looking for a Product Owner to support the development of Unify Analytics, RIB’s embedded analytics capability for the construction and AEC industry. Unify Analytics transforms complex project and business data into clear, interactive insights that help construction professionals make better decisions directly within their daily workflows. The product combines traditional visual analytics, configurable dashboards and AI-assisted chart and dashboard creation. In this role, you will work closely with Product Management, UX, Data Engineering & Analytics, software development, quality engineering and other product teams across the Unify platform. You will translate product direction and validated customer needs into clear, implementation-ready requirements and support the team throughout discovery, delivery and release. You will play a central role in establishing an AI-augmented product development approach in which specifications, UX designs, data semantics and technical contracts are consistently aligned before implementation begins. AI fluency is a baseline expectation for this position. We are looking for someone who does not merely use individual AI tools, but understands how to integrate AI into daily workflows, critically evaluate its output and continuously improve how product work is performed. Key responsibilities Own and refine the Unify Analytics backlog, translating strategy, customer needs and business requirements into clear epics, features and user stories. Define testable acceptance criteria, including performance, security, scalability and accessibility requirements. Align Product Management, UX, Data Engineering and R&D on workflows, data models, APIs, technical concepts and analytical experiences. Ensure sprint readiness, clarify requirements and coordinate dependencies, feature kick-offs and cross-team delivery. Support release planning, readiness, functional acceptance and communication of progress, risks and blockers. Establish responsible, repeatable AI-assisted workflows across discovery, requirements, refinement, analysis and documentation. Essential Requirements Several years of experience in product ownership, technical product ownership, project management or a comparable software-delivery role. Demonstrated experience managing Agile backlogs and participating in planning, refinement, reviews and retrospectives. Proven ability to translate complex business and user needs into clear, testable and implementation-ready requirements. Experience collaborating with architects, developers, data engineers, QA, DevOps and other technical stakeholders. Strong cross-team dependency management, stakeholder communication and experience in international or distributed teams. Professional fluency in English and demonstrated experience integrating AI-assisted tools into regular workflows. Desired Skills Strong user-story, acceptance-criteria and structured requirements-writing skills. Ability to turn ambiguous business problems into clear product behaviours and manageable delivery increments. Strong backlog-management, prioritisation and sprint-readiness capabilities. Ability to validate consistency across requirements, UX flows, data definitions, APIs and technical dependencies. Understanding of software-development lifecycles, integrations and tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira. Strong analytical thinking and the ability to balance customer value, strategy, dependencies and delivery capacity. AI Fluency Ability to integrate AI into daily product ownership and delivery workflows. Experience improving or redesigning concrete workflows through AI assistance. Strong judgement when reviewing AI-generated content for assumptions, inconsistencies and errors. Understanding of the need for human validation, accountability and appropriate source context. Ability to iteratively improve prompts, inputs, workflows and review mechanisms based on results. Commitment to responsible AI use that augments human expertise and acknowledges uncertainty and limitations. Preferred Experience Experience with analytics, business intelligence, reporting, dashboarding or data-driven software products. Understanding of KPIs, dimensions, filters, aggregations, semantic models and data quality. Familiarity with embedded analytics, self-service analytics or natural-language-driven product experiences. Experience with data platforms, pipelines or cloud-based analytics architectures. Experience supporting international SaaS products or working in the construction, engineering or AEC domain. Motivated By Our Values And Vision, We Drive Digital Transformation For Our Customers—for a Digital, More Efficient, And More Sustainable Engineering And Construction Industry. “Building Better Together” Is More Than Just a Slogan For Us. Because, Alongside Our Customers, You Are Our Priority. To Help You Fully Develop Your Passion For Your Work, We Support You With A structured start: individual onboarding, newcomer event, organized networking Goodies such as: employee discounts (e.g., corporate benefits), bonuses (e.g., for weddings, births, anniversaries), Schneider Electric stock ownership, health management (e.g., maternity leave counseling, medical advice, vaccinations, etc.) and, depending on location: foosball, dogs allowed Perks that are state-of-the-art for us: employee events (team events, summer parties, breakfast get-togethers, etc.), free parking spaces Modern working time model: trust-based working hours, flexible working hours/flexitime, option to work hybrid or remotely (see the information in the job advertisement for details) Career development/prospects: team- or role-based development/training, individual development/training, national and international career prospects within the RIB Group or Schneider Electric, etc. Opportunities to make an impact and shape the future: our values “IACT” (Impact, Aspiration, Curiosity, Trust) are not just marketing buzzwords, but are lived and breathed by us, proactive sharing of your ideas/approaches/process optimizations within the team, company idea management, active participation in team and management level meetings (“RIB Town Halls”), etc. Ways to be sustainable: digital infrastructure, modern equipment, and, depending on your role, an electric car as a company vehicle. UNTERNEHMENSKULTUR UND WERTE Motiviert durch unsere Werte kreieren wir eine corporate culture, in der wir ein klares Bild davon haben, wie wir miteinander interact, kommunizieren, arbeiten, führen/ coachen, supporten und unseren Nachwuchs fördern. Dabei steht immer der Mensch im Vordergrund! CHANCENGLEICHHEIT UND DIVERSITY RIB fördert die Chancengleichheit von Frauen und Männern in allen Funktionen und Tätigkeitsfeldern. Ganz gleich ob weibliche Führungskräfte, Mitarbeitende mit Behinderung, Berufseinsteigenden oder ältere Berufserfahrene – für uns zählt Engagement und die richtige Qualifikation. Der RIB Code of Conduct beschreibt dabei unsere wichtigsten Prinzipien in puncto Nationalität, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion,… RIB VISION Gebäude und Bauten sind für 36% des weltweiten Energieverbrauchs und fast 40% der energiebedingten CO2-Emissionen verantwortlich. Um die Branche effizienter, robuster und nachhaltiger zu machen, entwickeln wir Softwarelösungen, mit denen man im gesamten Lebenszyklus eines Bauwerks Ressourcen, Rohstoffe und Energie einsparen kann. Digitalisierung sehen wir als einen Treiber für eine nachhaltige Bauindustrie. "Building Better Together" steht dabei für das Zusammenspiel der beiden weltweit führenden Prozess- und Energietechnologien: RIB-Gruppe und Schneider Electric. Unser Manifest beschreibt unsere Überzeugungen und Werte, die uns bei unserer Arbeit antreiben und uns gemeinsam zu Höchstleistungen inspirieren: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lfqlC37lhzk https://www.rib-software.com/group/impressum
title: Agile Product Owner (m/f) Analytics Plattform | Scrum, AI & Data

description: Position: Growth Product Manager Reports to: Head of Product Location: Dublin, Ireland (no relocation) Employment Status: Full Time Salary Range: €85000 - €95000 annually About the Position At Sleep.ai, we do more than track sleep—we help people build healthier habits and improve their lives through better sleep. Across our consumer sleep apps, including DeinSchlaf in Germany and SleepScore globally, we are focused on creating engaging product experiences that help users get value quickly and stay motivated over time. We are looking for a Growth Product Manager to improve onboarding, app engagement, and lifecycle journeys across our consumer sleep apps. This role will focus on helping more users complete key milestones, especially 36 nights of sleep tracking, by improving onboarding flows, in-app guidance, and CRM nudges across push notifications and email. The role will also partner with our German marketing teams to support growth initiatives that drive app downloads and improve conversion from acquisition into sustained engagement. This is an ideal opportunity for a practical, hands-on product leader who has experience in consumer app growth, onboarding optimization, lifecycle/CRM, and retention. The ideal candidate is highly effective at identifying low-effort, high-impact improvements and can use the latest AI tools to accelerate UX recommendations, copy creation, prototyping, and product requirements while minimizing development effort and unnecessary experimentation. What You’ll Do Improve onboarding and activation experiences across SleepScore’s consumer sleep apps. Increase user engagement and progression toward key milestones, especially completion of 36 nights of sleep tracking. Design and optimize lifecycle journeys across push notifications, email, and in-app nudges to improve retention and habit formation. Partner closely with German marketing teams to support app growth initiatives that improve download-to-activation and acquisition-to-engagement conversion. Identify and prioritize lightweight product and UX improvements that are feasible within limited engineering capacity. Use product data, behavioral insights, and user journey analysis to identify friction points and opportunities for improvement. Collaborate across product, marketing, design, engineering, and CRM stakeholders to align priorities and deliver measurable outcomes. Use modern AI tools to accelerate analysis, ideation, prototyping, copy creation, and requirements development. Recommend practical experiments and improvements that maximize impact while reducing execution time and resource demands. What You Bring Experience in product growth, lifecycle CRM, retention, or onboarding optimization for consumer apps. Strong understanding of onboarding, engagement, activation, retention, and habit-forming user journeys. Demonstrated ability to improve conversion and engagement through lifecycle touchpoints such as push, email, and in-app messaging. Strong product instincts with a pragmatic, execution-focused approach. Ability to work cross-functionally with product, marketing, design, engineering, and analytics partners. Experience identifying high-impact, low-complexity product improvements in fast-moving environments. Comfort using AI tools to improve speed and quality across analysis, UX thinking, prototyping, and documentation. Strong communication skills and the ability to translate user behavior and growth opportunities into clear product actions. Bonus Points For Experience in sleep, digital health, wellness, or behavior-change products. Experience working with international teams, including Germany-based stakeholders. Familiarity with subscription, engagement, or retention models in mobile or consumer digital products. Experience improving app store conversion, onboarding completion, and lifecycle-driven re-engagement. Bilingual English/German. Thrive at Sleep.ai Because You Are Joining A mission-driven company dedicated to improving people’s physical, mental, and emotional well-being through better sleep. A team that values practical innovation, experimentation, and thoughtful product development. A culture that is kind, open, and collaborative, where diverse perspectives are welcomed and encouraged. An environment where modern tools, including AI, are embraced to improve speed, focus, and impact. A flexible working model designed to support collaboration while recognizing the realities of modern work. About Sleep.ai Sleep.Ai/SleepScore Labs is a leader in sleep science, research, and digital sleep solutions, helping people sleep better so they can live better. Through science-backed products, strategic partnerships, and personalized insights, Sleep.ai empowers users to build better sleep habits and improve overall well-being.
title: Growth Product Manager

description: About Cult - Curefit Healthcare Pvt Ltd, founded in 2016, is India’s largest fitness company and wellness platform. Cult, from the house of Curefit, was established with a mission to make fitness easy, fun and accessible to everyone, and has emerged as a community celebrating the joy of fitness. The brand today offers a range of fitness services ranging from group workouts, gyms and personalized fitness solutions, as well as an expansive selection of quality fitness products for the everyday athlete. The company’s vision is to empower everyone towards an active and healthier lifestyle through innovative fitness solutions, enabled by technology. Role Overview - We are looking for a Product Analyst who can own product analytics end-to-end from instrumentation and metric design to insight generation, experimentation, and roadmap influence. The role requires strong analytical depth, product judgment, and the ability to translate data into clear recommendations that drive product and business outcomes. Key Responsibilities Partner with Product, Engineering, Business, and Leadership teams to define product problems, success metrics, and analytical frameworks. Own product instrumentation and event tracking to ensure accurate measurement of features, launches, and user journeys. Analyze user behavior across funnels, retention, engagement, conversion, adoption, and monetization to generate actionable insights. Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and product health metrics to track performance and identify growth opportunities. Develop self-serve analytics solutions, reusable data models, and semantic layers to enable data-driven decision-making. Work with large datasets to uncover trends, risks, opportunities, and key business insights. Design and evaluate A/B tests and experiments, including sample sizing, metric selection, result interpretation, and recommendations. Identify and mitigate experimentation pitfalls such as biased samples, novelty effects, metric trade-offs, and low statistical power. Translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations that influence product strategy and roadmap decisions. Independently solve ambiguous product and business problems using structured, data-driven analysis. Collaborate with Data Engineering and Engineering teams to improve data quality, event tracking, and reporting processes. Present insights and recommendations effectively to both technical and business stakeholders, including senior leadership. Requirements 1–2 years of experience in Product Analytics, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, or a similar role. Strong hands-on experience with SQL and Python. Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and BI tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Looker. Good understanding of product metrics, funnels, retention, conversion, and A/B testing. Experience working with large datasets to generate actionable insights. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Good to Have Experience with Hive, Hadoop, Spark, BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake, or similar distributed data systems. Experience in consumer internet, marketplace, fitness, health-tech, subscription, or digital product companies. Prior experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Data Engineering, and Design teams. Strong product intuition and ability to connect user behavior with business impact.
title: Product Analyst - Growth

description: Job Description Hydrosat is a space and data analytics company building a new Earth observation constellation and software platform to unlock the power of thermal infrared imagery. We deliver high-resolution thermal insights that help governments, defense agencies, and agribusinesses better manage water resources, agricultural production, national security threats, and critical infrastructure. We grow through two distinct routes to market – government programmes, and commercial data and subscription products – and our product and engineering teams build the platform that powers both. We're looking for a product manager who will own the operating system that turns product decisions into shipped, high-quality product, in addition to bringing AI-first practices into the product development process. As we scale, we need to balance long-term vision and strategy with the need to move quickly and iterate based on customer feedback. This role bridges that gap. By taking ownership of the delivery engine – the process, speed, and quality of what we ship – you enable the organization to maintain high velocity while deepening our strategic focus. You'll also bring in AI and associated tools to accelerate the product development process: hands-on prototyping, building workflow automations, and driving adoption across the product team. This role reports into the Head of Product and works closely with UX design, software and data engineering, science and customer success teams, and product marketing. This is an execution-first role with a clear growth path: as the platform scales and new use cases come online, there is scope to own a product surface end-to-end. Responsibilities Product Delivery (~70–80%) Translate roadmap priorities into detailed engineering requirements and acceptance criteria. Own the UX handoff process with the designer: polished interactions, resolved edge cases, defined state management. Manage sprint execution, track delivery against commitments, and proactively flag risks. Coordinate dependencies across engineering, science, and other teams. Run the operating cadence: standups, sprint reviews, status updates, and launch readiness. Manage prioritization of customer requests, providing transparency on timelines and decisions to the customer success team and other stakeholders. AI-First Processes (~20–30%) Introduce AI prototyping and automation tools into the product development workflow. Identify high-impact manual workflows and build proofs of concept for agentic workflows. Drive change management for AI adoption across the product team. Be a credible discussion partner with engineering on AI/agentic capabilities for the product itself. Job Requirements End-to-End Product Delivery: You have owned delivery end-to-end in a product organization, from requirements gathering and definition, through backlog management, UX handoffs, and UAT. Engineering and Science Partnership: You have experience working alongside software and data engineering teams, as well as science teams. Decision Making: You are comfortable making product decisions at your level, with the maturity to know when to escalate critical blockers, and can manage complex tradeoffs between functionality, UX, and customer value. Basic Technical Literacy: You have a basic understanding of software development building blocks and machine learning concepts, allowing you to speak the engineering and science team's language with some guidance. Ownership & Validation: You have a strong sense of ownership and the ability to propose and validate ideas using a balanced combination of data and sound judgment. Prioritization: You use established prioritization frameworks to manage requests from multiple customers, ensuring clear and rapid communication between product, engineering, and customer success teams, and feel comfortable saying “no” while keeping stakeholders' trust. AI-Native Execution: You have hands-on experience building with AI tools (prototyping, coding, agents, automation) and can identify where AI can drive innovation, accelerate decision-making, or automate processes. Nice to Have Advanced Technical Fluency: Experience in data-heavy or technically complex products – ML pipelines, geospatial data, satellite imagery, scientific computing – with a real understanding of system development, able to engage in highly technical discussions with engineering or science teams and propose solutions, not just requirements. Change Management: A track record of driving process or behavior change in an organization, with a specific example of moving people from old ways of working to new ones, especially when they didn't initially ask for it. Advanced AI Builder: Experience creating multiple complex applications using state-of-the-art AI practices and tools, able to move from idea to high-fidelity prototype (API integration, rich visualizations, etc.) in hours or days, with a strong point of view on when to use AI and when not to. B2B SaaS Expertise: Experience in B2B SaaS, especially platforms serving multiple use cases or customer segments on shared infrastructure. Domain Experience: Experience in AgTech, environmental tech, precision agriculture, or an adjacent domain where domain expertise and technical depth intersect. Benefits Competitive compensation package Stock options to share in Hydrosat’s long-term success Fast-moving, mission-driven startup environment with real ownership Hybrid work model with flexibility EU visa sponsorship available when required Attractive Luxembourg tax advantages for relocators + relocation bonus Meal vouchers included Living and working in Luxembourg - explainer for newcomers International Schooling, Transport, Quality of Life Testimonials
title: AI-Native Product Delivery Manager

description: Geef vorm aan de toekomst van een toonaangevend SaaS-product Ben jij een klantgerichte productmanager die strategie weet te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen, sterke productervaringen helpt vormgeven en resultaat wilt neerzetten? Als Product Manager speel je een belangrijke rol in het succes van een productdomein binnen een portfolio van toonaangevende softwareoplossingen in Nederland, België en het Verenigd Koninkrijk. In deze rol komen klantinzichten, productrealisatie, commerciële doelen en innovatie samen. Je draagt bij aan het vormgeven en realiseren van productinitiatieven die groei ondersteunen, klantwaarde verhogen en ervoor zorgen dat onze oplossingen competitief blijven in een snel veranderende markt. De rol De accountancymarkt bevindt zich in een fase van snelle verandering en groei, gedreven door Cloud technologie en de opkomst van AI-ondersteunde workflows. Je werkt mee aan de ontwikkeling en oplevering van softwareoplossingen binnen pre-accounting, accounting/boekhouding en ERP. Als onderdeel van een multidisciplinair team help je om klantbehoeften en productstrategie te vertalen naar duidelijke functionaliteiten en verbeteringen, zodat er consistent waarde wordt geleverd. Wat ga je doen? Ondersteunen bij de uitvoering van de product roadmap voor een afgebakend productdomein Vertalen van strategie naar functionaliteiten, user stories en requirements Samenwerken met engineering en design om features te realiseren Bijdragen aan backlogbeheer en agile werkwijzen Verzamelen van klantfeedback en analyseren van productdata Meewerken aan de ontwikkeling van AI-ondersteunde functionaliteiten Opvolgen van product-KPI’s en signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden Samenwerken met Product, Technologie, Sales en Marketing Jouw profiel Ervaring in productmanagement of een vergelijkbare rol Sterke interesse in software, technologie en klantbeleving Analytisch sterk en oplossingsgericht Ervaring met samenwerken in teams om resultaten te behalen Kennis van agile werken (of bereid dit te leren) Ervaring met SaaS- of cloudoplossingen is een plus Interesse in AI en nieuwe technologieën is een plus Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en hebt een goede beheersing van het Engels Soft Skills Je bent nieuwsgierig, proactief en leergierig, en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk met oog voor detail. Je werkt goed samen in multidisciplinaire teams en communiceert helder, zodat iedereen goed aangehaakt blijft. Je pakt vraagstukken gestructureerd aan en voelt je comfortabel om vragen te stellen, feedback te vragen en jezelf continu te verbeteren. Je past je makkelijk aan in een dynamische omgeving en staat open voor verandering en nieuwe ideeën, waaronder nieuwe technologieën. Je haalt voldoening uit het leveren van concrete resultaten voor klanten en het bijdragen aan het succes van het team en het product. Waarom deze rol bij ons? Bij Wolters Kluwer werk je aan software die essentieel is voor de dagelijkse praktijk van duizenden boekhouders en accountants. Je krijgt de kans om mee te bouwen aan een product met een sterke positie in de markt en een duidelijke rol in onze groei. Tegelijkertijd werk je in een stabiele, internationale organisatie waar expertise, kwaliteit en samenwerking centraal staan, en waar ruimte is om je verder te ontwikkelen. Over Wolters Kluwer Wolters Kluwer is een wereldleider in professionele informatiediensten. Professionals in de juridische, zakelijke, fiscale, accountancy-, financiële, audit-, risk-, compliance- en zorgsector vertrouwen op onze tools en softwareoplossingen om hun werk efficiënt uit te voeren. Wij tellen 20.000 medewerkers in meer dan 40 landen. Wat bieden wij? Een rol als Product Manager binnen een toonaangevende SaaS-organisatie Hybride werken, met Hoevelaken als standplaats Een competitief salaris met aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden Samenwerking met ervaren professionals in een internationale omgeving Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en groei Klaar om het verschil te maken? Wil jij jouw interesse in productmanagement inzetten om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van accountingsoftware? Solliciteer vandaag nog en ontdek wat jij kunt betekenen als Product Manager bij Wolters Kluwer . Heb je vragen? Neem gerust contact op: ina.smaelen@wolterskluwer.com Our Interview Practices To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process. Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.
title: Product Manager

description: How do you make our customers happy? Payments that clear instantly. An effortless Buy-Now-Pay-Later option. Fraud prevention that squashes threats without disrupting customers. Seamless financial experiences require excellent data capabilities. In this role, you are the authority on FinTech product analytics. You mature the data craft, scale analytical practices, and elevate data literacy across teams, ensuring that financial data translates into product clarity across Payments, Buy Now Pay Later, Fraud Prevention, Invoicing, and Collections. Your work helps 13.7 million customers take our financial products for granted. And that's probably the highest compliment in FinTech. The biggest challenge Traversing a tightrope between tech depth and business relevance. You're expected to propel the analytical craft - better frameworks, better experimentation, better tooling - while ensuring that every insight is accessible and actionable for product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders. Who all think in different vocabularies. Add to that: you're the lead data steward for your domain, responsible for data quality and governance. And you mentor product analysts without managing them, so influencing without hierarchy should come naturally. How do you set the standard for analytical excellence while keeping everyone aligned? What you will do as Expert Product Analyst - FinTech You'll work within the FinTech domain, collaborating closely with product analysts, the Managers of Product Analytics (who focus on enabling product strategy with heads of product and business stakeholders), and the data department. From an outside-in perspective, you’ll introduce best practices that shape the future of analytics. This is a craft leadership role; you lead on methodology, quality, and innovation. People management responsibilities, including performance reviews, reside with the Manager of Product Analytics. Your focus? Making everyone around you better at analytics. Your key responsibilities: Lead domain-level analytics and experimentation initiatives that directly improve product strategy and execution Develop scalable, reliable analytical frameworks that support decision-making across FinTech product teams Act as the lead data steward for your domain: own data quality, governance, and ensure analytical outputs are trustworthy Mentor and upskill product analysts, fostering a culture of data literacy and continuous improvement Drive the adoption of dashboards and analytics tools, making insights accessible and actionable, not just available Champion experimentation and outcome validation, including A/B testing, driver trees, and effort measurement Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders across teams to embed analytics into the core of how teams work Introduce technical innovations by leveraging cloud technologies and advanced analytical methods Maintain strong ties with the data department, implementing an outside-in perspective and best practices that shape the future of analytics at bol Why you can make a difference You combine in-depth technical expertise with the ability to make complex data clear and actionable. You have advanced SQL and BigQuery skills, and you're proficient in Python for data analysis. You build dashboards in Looker Studio that colleagues are eager to use, and you're familiar with Google Cloud services and scalable data solutions. These technical skills aside, it’s imperative that you can translate analytical complexity into language that product managers trust, engineers respect, and leadership acts on. Your stakeholder management is on point, your communication is clear, and you have a passion for mentoring. That’s how you maximize your impact. You also have a continuous improvement mindset and stay abreast of developments in analytical methodology and technology. Where you'll be working You'll join the FinTech analytics function, working at the intersection of Payments, Buy Now Pay Later, Fraud Prevention, Invoicing, and Collections. You’ll collaborate with product analysts, product managers, engineers, and the central data department. In 2026, the focus is on strengthening the analytics community, increasing self-service adoption through a more powerful data platform and AI-driven solutions, and investing in outcome validation. With 13.7 million customers and 47.000 partners relying on financial services that need to be both reliable and innovative, your analytical craft directly shapes how bol builds, measures, and improves its financial products. Something for you? Canny craft leader: You define what great product analytics looks like and raise the standard for everyone around you. Fluent translator: You transition effortlessly between technical depth and business context. Steward and strategist: You care about data quality and governance because you know that trusted data is the foundation on which everything else is built. Nothing for you? Job-title-driven: You crave direct reports and insist on performance review authority. Influencing without it would be impossible. Insight mystic: Your analyses are brilliant, but you lack the skills to communicate them effectively. Status quo sailor: You're perfectly comfortable with existing frameworks and tools. Sailing the data sea calls for a time-tested vessel. We take pride in our B Corp certification and strive for continuous improvement every day. Our annual bonus is tied to sustainability goals, and we are committed to equality and equal opportunities for all. description: Geef vorm aan de toekomst van een toonaangevend SaaS-product Ben jij een klantgerichte productmanager die strategie weet te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen, sterke productervaringen helpt vormgeven en resultaat wilt neerzetten? Als Product Manager speel je een belangrijke rol in het succes van een productdomein binnen een portfolio van toonaangevende softwareoplossingen in Nederland, België en het Verenigd Koninkrijk. In deze rol komen klantinzichten, productrealisatie, commerciële doelen en innovatie samen. Je draagt bij aan het vormgeven en realiseren van productinitiatieven die groei ondersteunen, klantwaarde verhogen en ervoor zorgen dat onze oplossingen competitief blijven in een snel veranderende markt. De rol De accountancymarkt bevindt zich in een fase van snelle verandering en groei, gedreven door Cloud technologie en de opkomst van AI-ondersteunde workflows. Je werkt mee aan de ontwikkeling en oplevering van softwareoplossingen binnen pre-accounting, accounting/boekhouding en ERP. Als onderdeel van een multidisciplinair team help je om klantbehoeften en productstrategie te vertalen naar duidelijke functionaliteiten en verbeteringen, zodat er consistent waarde wordt geleverd. Wat ga je doen? Ondersteunen bij de uitvoering van de product roadmap voor een afgebakend productdomein Vertalen van strategie naar functionaliteiten, user stories en requirements Samenwerken met engineering en design om features te realiseren Bijdragen aan backlogbeheer en agile werkwijzen Verzamelen van klantfeedback en analyseren van productdata Meewerken aan de ontwikkeling van AI-ondersteunde functionaliteiten Opvolgen van product-KPI’s en signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden Samenwerken met Product, Technologie, Sales en Marketing Jouw profiel Ervaring in productmanagement of een vergelijkbare rol Sterke interesse in software, technologie en klantbeleving Analytisch sterk en oplossingsgericht Ervaring met samenwerken in teams om resultaten te behalen Kennis van agile werken (of bereid dit te leren) Ervaring met SaaS- of cloudoplossingen is een plus Interesse in AI en nieuwe technologieën is een plus Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en hebt een goede beheersing van het Engels Soft Skills Je bent nieuwsgierig, proactief en leergierig, en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk met oog voor detail. Je werkt goed samen in multidisciplinaire teams en communiceert helder, zodat iedereen goed aangehaakt blijft. Je pakt vraagstukken gestructureerd aan en voelt je comfortabel om vragen te stellen, feedback te vragen en jezelf continu te verbeteren. Je past je makkelijk aan in een dynamische omgeving en staat open voor verandering en nieuwe ideeën, waaronder nieuwe technologieën. Je haalt voldoening uit het leveren van concrete resultaten voor klanten en het bijdragen aan het succes van het team en het product. Waarom deze rol bij ons? Bij Wolters Kluwer werk je aan software die essentieel is voor de dagelijkse praktijk van duizenden boekhouders en accountants. Je krijgt de kans om mee te bouwen aan een product met een sterke positie in de markt en een duidelijke rol in onze groei. Tegelijkertijd werk je in een stabiele, internationale organisatie waar expertise, kwaliteit en samenwerking centraal staan, en waar ruimte is om je verder te ontwikkelen. Over Wolters Kluwer Wolters Kluwer is een wereldleider in professionele informatiediensten. Professionals in de juridische, zakelijke, fiscale, accountancy-, financiële, audit-, risk-, compliance- en zorgsector vertrouwen op onze tools en softwareoplossingen om hun werk efficiënt uit te voeren. Wij tellen 20.000 medewerkers in meer dan 40 landen. Wat bieden wij? Een rol als Product Manager binnen een toonaangevende SaaS-organisatie Hybride werken, met Hoevelaken als standplaats Een competitief salaris met aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden Samenwerking met ervaren professionals in een internationale omgeving Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en groei Klaar om het verschil te maken? Wil jij jouw interesse in productmanagement inzetten om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van accountingsoftware? Solliciteer vandaag nog en ontdek wat jij kunt betekenen als Product Manager bij Wolters Kluwer . Heb je vragen? Neem gerust contact op: ina.smaelen@wolterskluwer.com Our Interview Practices To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process. Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

description: Performance Analyst We’re looking for a Performance Analyst to join our Gaming Team at Betfair part of Flutter UK & Ireland. As a Performance Analyst you will have an exciting opportunity to play a central role in influencing our Customer Engagement, Cross-Sell and Acquisition strategies through insights to drive performance, with exposure to stakeholders of all levels. What You’ll Be Working On Monitor performance to ensure targets are met and decisions can be made in a timely manner. Identify and communicate opportunities / challenges to relevant stakeholders along with solutions and advice to maximise performance. Generate reusable reports using different analytical tools allowing stakeholders to self-serve. Produce in-depth pieces of analysis and strategic insights to provide a detailed explanation of underlying trends and recommendations. How You’ll Play To Win Adopt a long-term view and anticipate future trends and implications. Ability to clearly communicate findings in a concise and effective manner, as well as actively listens with intent and appreciates the opinion of others. Thinks about customers 24/7 and puts them at the heart of all that we do. Gets stuck in to achieve results, confident when under pressure and comfortable giving opinions. Highly enthusiastic and willing to learn; wants to understand behaviour, look for patterns and find great things. Excellent data manipulation skills in Excel with a special emphasis on producing output appropriate to the audience. Set your own odds and start a career with Betfair. Our ambition is to change our industry for the better, making use of our significant scale and challenger mentality. We’re working to be an inclusive employer, and we encourage people from all backgrounds, ways of thinking and working to apply. Everyone brings different perspectives and experiences; you don't have to meet all the requirements listed to apply for this role. If you need any adjustments to make this role work for you let us know, and we’ll see how we can accommodate them.

description: Your career at Deutsche Börse Group Your area of work: As a Product Owner, you will support and drive key workstreams within the digital and DLT infrastructure, functionalities and products roadmap, working closely with the senior product owner and wider product leadership team. You will help translate strategic priorities, legal and regulatory considerations, and stakeholder needs into clear requirements, delivery plans and market-ready service capabilities. The role is suited to a responsible, self-driven professional who is looking to grow into a product role by applying strong project management, stakeholder engagement and structured problem-solving skills, while bringing stakeholders together across business, legal, technology and delivery teams and driving delivery against agreed targets and deadlines. Your responsibilities: Lead assigned digital and DLT infrastructure, functionalities and product workstreams, supporting the execution of the roadmap from requirements definition through implementation and production readiness. Lead the development of Product Requirement Documents, ensuring requirements are clearly documented, traceable and aligned with the smart contract data model, data distribution model and digital service scope. Ensure key business, functional and technical items are captured as clear backlog items, user stories and delivery priorities, and are prioritised according to business value, regulatory impact, technical dependencies and delivery constraints. Drive stakeholder alignment across business, legal, technology and delivery teams, bringing the right stakeholders together and ensuring open questions, dependencies and decisions are clearly captured and followed up. Support backlog refinement and prioritization based on business value, regulatory impact, technical dependencies and delivery constraints, under the guidance of the senior product owner. Define clear, testable user stories and acceptance criteria, supporting validation of digital and tokenized services, wallet journeys and data distribution requirements. Support sprint planning, reviews, demos, stakeholder feedback and functional/BAT testing, while helping to manage timelines, delivery milestones and readiness of new digital and DLT-enabled services and related service documentation. Your profile: University degree in economics, finance, business administration, law, computer science or a comparable field. 7+ years of experience in capital markets, financial services, legal/regulatory, market infrastructure, transformation or comparable stakeholder-driven environments. Demonstrated ability to coordinate and manage complex projects, structure work across multiple stakeholders, track dependencies and drive progress against agreed targets and deadlines. Interest in developing a strong understanding of securities lifecycle processes, CSD operating models, market member needs and readiness requirements. Strong enthusiasm to learn and develop expertise in digital and DLT-based financial market infrastructure, related functionalities and products. Ability to translate legal, regulatory, business and stakeholder considerations into clear requirements, delivery priorities and practical implementation actions. Good judgement in identifying open questions, risks, dependencies and decisions, and ensuring these are transparently captured, escalated and followed up. Strong analytical, problem-solving and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance business value, regulatory impact, technical dependencies and delivery constraints. Responsible, proactive and self-driven working style, with the ability to lead assigned topics independently while escalating key decisions appropriately. Confidence in engaging with senior stakeholders, preparing structured materials, facilitating discussions and ensuring decisions and follow-up actions are clearly documented. Excellent stakeholder management, customer orientation, communication and presentation skills across business, legal, technology and delivery teams. Written and spoken English is mandatory; German, French or any other language is an asset.

description: Who are we? Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world. We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios. Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users. Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others. We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games. Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started. The role is working within our studio: Lion Studios Lion Studios is a mobile games publisher that works with mobile developers to get their games discovered by players around the world. Headquartered in San Francisco, Lion Studios’ creative and strategy teams utilize their expertise to help game developers break through the noise and grow their businesses. Since launching in 2018, Lion Studios has driven 90% of its games to the Top 10 in the App Store and Google Play and helped drive 16 games to #1 in the US App Store’s Top Free chart. Role Overview We're looking for a Product Scientist to join our small but fast-moving product analytics team. You'll own experimentation and data-driven decision-making across our mobile games portfolio — designing and analyzing A/B tests, building user segmentations, uncovering product insights, and directly influencing how millions of players experience our games. This isn't a role where you'll wait for someone to hand you a task. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with product managers, game designers, and engineers — proactively identifying opportunities, challenging assumptions, and turning data into real product impact. We move fast, ship often, and actively use AI tools to accelerate our analyses and workflows. Key Responsibilities Design, run, and evaluate A/B tests across multiple game titles — ensuring experiments are statistically rigorous and lead to clear, actionable outcomes. Define and monitor success metrics (retention, monetization, engagement) and build analytical frameworks that drive product decisions. Perform deep-dive analyses: user segmentation, cohort analysis, funnel breakdowns, and predictive modeling to surface growth and retention opportunities. Translate business questions into data requirements — working with engineering to ensure proper event tracking and data reliability. Build dashboards and reports that communicate insights to stakeholders clearly and effectively. Collaborate with product teams to develop hypotheses, prioritize experiments, and foster a culture of continuous learning and rapid iteration. Leverage AI tools and automation to speed up analyses, generate insights, and improve team efficiency. Required Skills, Knowledge And Expertise 2–4 years of experience in product analytics, data science, or a similar quantitative role — ideally in mobile gaming, apps, or a fast-paced tech environment. Strong A/B testing expertise: you can design experiments end-to-end, choose appropriate statistical methods, interpret results, and communicate trade-offs. Proficient in SQL — you're comfortable writing complex queries and working with large datasets. Python or R for data analysis, statistical modeling, and automation. Segmentation & cohort analysis experience — you know how to slice user behavior to find what matters. Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field (statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science, or similar). A thesis or research experience is a strong plus. Self-starter mentality — you thrive with autonomy, take ownership, and execute quickly in a dynamic environment. Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). Working at Tripledot 25 days holiday: Enjoy 20 days of paid holiday plus an additional 5 days per annum, in addition to bank holidays to relax and refresh throughout the year. Continuous Professional Development: Propel your career with continuous opportunities for professional development. Supplemental Health Insurance: Continentale: annual budget of 1200 eur - reimbursement for healthcare outside of public plans (glasses, messages, dental treatments etc.) Public Transportation reimbursement: 100% of public transportation to the office via BVG ticket is covered Employee Assistance Program: Anytime you need it, tap into confidential, caring support with our Employee Assistance Program, always here to lend an ear and a helping hand. Daily Free Lunch: Order free food from Wolt when at the office Pension plan: Opt-in to employer contributed pension plan, operated with Degura
